name: environments-demo
description: Roku showcase for flash-theater's environments feature — env.<name> reads, environments/<name>.config.json, manifestOverrides, local overrides, and include/exclude glob patterns — this topic's own dedicated, router-mounted chapter app (see findings/demo-app-conventions.md). Unlike every other chapter app, every chapter here reads env.* so there is no meaningful plain build; see scripts/with-env.mjs.

scripts.build:roku: npm run compile && npm run zip
